user_statement: I've checked new D26/N2 modes - continuum crossing looks fine, most mode are numerical , but few might be ok, for example 2817 and 2650. So it seems this shot is ok now
shot_name_interpretation: D26 treated as D46: current discussion and both cited N2 filenames match the D46 review list; neither inventory contains a D26 shot.
review_scope: Visual acceptance of N2 TAE-like and mixed continuum correspondence; shot released for TAE production sorting.
retained_limitations: N2 offsets remain unmeasured by the log diagnostic because no current exact-frequency log matches are available.
Potential EAE correspondence findings remain separate; the upper EAE boundary is unavailable.
